user.title: Select Sensors
user.description: Choose the sensors to use for the compensation curve calculation. Parameters can be adjusted on the device page after setup.

data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Required. The sensor measuring outdoor temperature in °C.
data_description.wind_speed_sensor: Optional. Wind speed in km/h. Leave empty to disable wind compensation.
data_description.sunlight_sensor: Optional. Solar irradiance in W/m². Leave empty to disable solar compensation.
data_description.heat_demand_sensor: Optional. Heat demand in °C (difference between target and current room temperature). Leave empty to disable heat demand compensation.
